description: This file defines the internal class ImplicitChannelSubscriberTable which manages implicit subscriptions in Orleans broadcasts, including cache management, pattern matching for channel namespaces, and creation of grain references for broadcast consumers.

classes.name: ImplicitChannelSubscriberTable
classes.description: Manages implicit broadcast channel subscriptions, including cache management, namespace pattern matching, and creation of consumer references.

methods.name: ImplicitChannelSubscriberTable
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the subscriber table with bindings, providers, and service provider.

methods.name: GetCache
methods.description: Retrieves the current cache, rebuilding it if the bindings have changed.

methods.name: BuildCache
methods.description: Builds a new cache with predicates for implicit subscribers based on current bindings.

methods.name: GetImplicitSubscribers
methods.description: Returns a dictionary of subscriber GUIDs to consumer extensions for a given channel ID.

methods.name: GetOrAddImplicitSubscribers
methods.description: Gets or creates the set of implicit subscribers for a specific namespace.

methods.name: MakeSubscriptionGuid
methods.description: Creates a unique subscription GUID based on grain type, channel ID, and provider name.

methods.name: FindImplicitSubscribers
methods.description: Finds all subscribers matching a given namespace based on predicates.

methods.name: MakeConsumerReference
methods.description: Creates a grain reference to a broadcast channel consumer extension.

inner_classes.name: BroadcastChannelSubscriberPredicate
inner_classes.description: Associates a subscriber with its namespace predicate.

inner_classes.name: BroadcastChannelSubscriber
inner_classes.description: Represents a subscriber with methods for comparison and grain ID creation.

inner_classes.name: Cache
inner_classes.description: Holds cached predicates and namespace mappings, with versioning for cache invalidation.
